title: pretty ESMÉE|Plus Size A-Line V-Neck See-Through Long Sleeves Shiny Belt Chiffon Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Embrace your curves and exude confidence in this stunning Plus Size A-Line V-Neck See-Through Long Sleeves Shiny Belt Chiffon Evening Dress. Whether it's a gala, wedding, or cocktail party, this dress is sure to make you the center of attention with its flattering silhouette and alluring see-through sleeves.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style:Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
